Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for an automatic stay of any order terminating parental rights.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to staying an order terminating parental rights;and adding a new section to chapter 26.33 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 26.33 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An order terminating a person's parental rights that is enteredin a proceeding initiated under either chapter 13.34 RCW or thischapter shall be automatically stayed for thirty days after entry ofthe order terminating parental rights. If a notice of appeal is filedwith respect to the termination order during the thirtyday period, theautomatic stay shall continue until the appeal is complete or the stayis lifted by the reviewing court. If a notice of appeal is not filedwithin the thirtyday period, the automatic stay shall expire. (2) The automatic stay under this section shall stay the executionof the termination order to the extent that it would permit entry of anorder of adoption without the parent's consent or surrender, and shallalso stay the termination order with respect to any power granted to a p. 1 SB 5597person or agency to consent to an adoption.
